text: expenses: web — data layer, arithmetic, and all screens

Cross-client agreement guard: the split and balance case tables live in ONE
file at the repo root, shared-test-cases/expense-arithmetic.json, and both the
Kotlin and the TypeScript tests read it (Android via a relative File path from
the module, the way TranslationResourcesTest reads res/; web via import).
Whichever of T-153 / T-155 lands first creates it; the other consumes it. Do
not maintain two copies — that is exactly how the i18n fixture drifted (T-148).
